categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment, focusing on the research, production, and sales of metal (Selective Laser Melting, SLM) and polymer (Selective Laser Sintering, SLS) 3D printing devices. It also provides 3D printing materials, processes, and services, with applications in aerospace, automotive, medical, mold, sports footwear, and electronics industries. The company offers a comprehensive product line including over 20 models of 3D printers and more than 40 specialized materials and processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include SLM and SLS additive manufacturing processes, proprietary industrial software systems for data processing and equipment control, and self-developed 3D printing materials. The company has developed advanced multi-laser scanning control, high-precision optical and thermal field designs, automated powder spreading, and intelligent manufacturing execution systems (MES). It also innovates in cold metal fusion technology and high-strength composite materials, emphasizing automation, efficiency, precision, and scalability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial users in aerospace, automotive, medical, mold manufacturing, sports footwear, consumer electronics, and emerging sectors like low-altitude economy and new energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including the US and Europe, with a focus on industrial-scale additive manufacturing applications and customized solutions for batch production and complex part manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changsha, Hunan Province, and has established subsidiaries in the United States (Austin, Texas) and Germany (Stuttgart) to support global sales, technical support, and after-sales services. Its international sales network covers over 30 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the additive manufacturing supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of 3D printing equipment and materials. It procures key components such as lasers and galvanometers from international suppliers but produces most other parts domestically. It also provides downstream services including 3D printing production and technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in additive manufacturing equipment, materials, software, and processes to enhance efficiency, precision, and scalability. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on multi-laser systems, high-temperature polymer sintering, automated powder handling, and intelligent manufacturing execution systems. It aims to achieve full domestic control of core components, expand applications in aerospace and automotive sectors, and develop next-generation technologies for industrial-scale additive manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of 3D printing equipment (metal and polymer), 3D printing materials, and related after-sales services including maintenance, upgrades, and technical consulting. The company employs a combination of direct sales and channel distribution domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment manufacturer in China and ranks among the top globally. It competes with international firms such as EOS, HP, and SLM Solutions. Despite being younger and smaller than some multinational competitors, it has established a strong market presence through proprietary technology, comprehensive product offerings, and international expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 492 million, a decrease of 18.82% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 67.2 million, down 48.76%. Despite revenue and profit declines due to market demand fluctuations and increased costs, the company increased R&D investment by 20.06% to nearly RMB 99 million, representing 20.10% of revenue. Total assets grew by 7.87% to approximately RMB 2.5 billion, reflecting ongoing capacity expansion and capital investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully independent intellectual property system, integrating equipment, software, and materials with complete domestic control, which differentiates it from competitors reliant on imported technologies. It offers a broad product range with customizable configurations, high precision, large build volumes, and multi-laser systems for efficient batch production. Its open software platform allows customers to adjust core process parameters and supports third-party materials, lowering barriers to adoption and enabling tailored industrial solutions.
